method: view_image of actual on-disk original and proportional 360/680 PNGs, each at original detail; direct visual inspection, not metadata alone
observedFindings: The operator-bound blue repressor precedes three gene blocks on the same bacterial DNA line.
After the targeted imagegen edit, the inhibition connection has one target end-bar at polymerase and no source end-bar; the grey onward arrow is absent.
The chromatin side and its access/movement motif were retained; essential labels and both mechanisms remain clear at 360 and 680 widths.
limitations: This is a generic operon orientation, not a complete lac model.
Accessibility is a condition for regulation, not an unconditional guarantee of expression.
The unchanged material cases supply the induction, epigenetic and mutation distinctions.
altTextDe: Ein Repressor am Operator eines schematischen Operons hemmt die Polymerase; drei Genblöcke folgen auf derselben DNA. Daneben zeigt Chromatin einen zugänglichen DNA-Abschnitt zwischen Histonen.
altTextEn: A repressor at the operator of a schematic operon inhibits polymerase; three gene blocks follow along the same DNA. Beside it, chromatin shows an accessible DNA region between histones.
